# VS Code / Copilot — External Advisory Rules

**Advisory only — Hermes Constitution supersedes.**

Merge with [`vscode_copilot_instructions.md`](../vscode_copilot_instructions.md). Mount source: `hermes/skills/external/karpathy_guidelines/SKILL.md`.

## Advisory coding heuristics

- Surface assumptions and tradeoffs before large edits.
- Prefer the smallest correct change set.
- Avoid drive-by refactors outside the user request.
- Tie work to verifiable checks (tests, lint, typecheck).

Guardian and canonical rules remain mandatory for side effects.
